% ADDED figure (2026-11-09): C8 Quantum Electrodynamics; generated by qft-C/tools/l18/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % particle (left line, arrows up) and antiparticle (right line, arrows reversed); time runs upward
  \newcommand{\ffbarlegs}{%
    \coordinate (v1) at (-0.9,0); \coordinate (v2) at (0.9,0);
    \coordinate (a) at (-1.75,-1.2); \coordinate (b) at (-1.75,1.2);
    \coordinate (c) at (1.75,-1.2); \coordinate (d) at (1.75,1.2);
    \draw[fline] (a)--(v1); \draw[fline] (v1)--(b);
    \draw[fline] (v2)--(c); \draw[fline] (d)--(v2);
    % momentum arrows: all four momenta run upward (forward in time)
    \draw[fdmom] ($(a)!0.28!(v1)+(-0.17,0.12)$)--($(a)!0.72!(v1)+(-0.17,0.12)$);
    \draw[fdmom] ($(v1)!0.28!(b)+(-0.17,-0.12)$)--($(v1)!0.72!(b)+(-0.17,-0.12)$);
    \draw[fdmom] ($(c)!0.28!(v2)+(0.17,0.12)$)--($(c)!0.72!(v2)+(0.17,0.12)$);
    \draw[fdmom] ($(v2)!0.28!(d)+(0.17,-0.12)$)--($(v2)!0.72!(d)+(0.17,-0.12)$);
    \node[fdlab,left] at (a) {$p,s$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (b) {$p',s'$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (c) {$k,r$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (d) {$k',r'$};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (-1.75,-1.5) {$f_1$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (1.75,-1.5) {$\bar f_2$};
  }
  \begin{scope}
    \ffbarlegs
    \draw[sline] (v1)--(v2); \node[fdv] at (v1) {}; \node[fdv] at (v2) {};
    \draw[fdmom] (-0.35,0.25)--(0.35,0.25); \node[fdlab,above] at (0,0.25) {$p-p'$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-2.75) {(a) Yukawa, particle--antiparticle\\[2pt] $(-1)\,(-ig)^2\,\bar u(p')u(p)\,\dfrac{i}{(p-p')^2-m_\phi^2+i\varepsilon}\,\bar v(k)v(k')$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=8.6cm]
    \ffbarlegs
    \draw[pline] (v1)--(v2); \node[fdv] at (v1) {}; \node[fdv] at (v2) {};
    \draw[fdmom] (-0.35,0.32)--(0.35,0.32); \node[fdlab,above] at (0,0.32) {$p-p'$};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (-0.9,-0.1) {$\mu$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (0.9,-0.1) {$\nu$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-2.75) {(b) QED, particle--antiparticle\\[2pt] $(-1)\,(-ie)^2\,\bar u(p')\gamma^\mu u(p)\,\dfrac{-ig_{\mu\nu}}{(p-p')^2+i\varepsilon}\,\bar v(k)\gamma^\nu v(k')$};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
